Hypnotic Swedish model walks but does not talk.

That first story was influenced by M R James famous short story 'The Mezzotint,' no doubt in my mind: a picture of a house in that story comes to life, and a figure slowly approaches the house, and then leaves it (carrying a 'bundle'), very slowly. Unlike the movie the picture was bought in auction and the artist was unknown. Back to the movie. Well perhaps worth noting each of the 'victims' in the first two episodes never s

Lon Cheney is great, free of some of the stereotypical roles he palyed elsewhere and very confident in this role. Admittedly it's not mainstream movie material but in a way that helps to improve the feeling of Mystery. I got no feeling of scandanavian culture but some of the settings came over as "different". That said the Bristish copper seemd a little out of place. You could do worse...
